_about: Rate sheet data for Waqar-e-Madina Group (WMT), read from the two supplier PDFs named in _sourceFiles. Hotel names, cities, distances, aliases and prices are transcribed from those sheets. Nothing here is invented.
_checks: Every printed per-person figure was verified to equal ceil(room / occupancy) for occupancies 5, 4, 3 and 2. Test cases T1, T2, T4 and T6 in docs/03 section 7 were reproduced from this data and match.
_howToUse: `hotels` is the master list the Phase 2 seed reads. `extractions` is one entry per sheet page, in the shape of the extraction schema in docs/03 section 3, for use as Phase 3 fixtures.

_notes: The two PDFs carry the same three packs at the same prices. They differ in two ways, both of which are useful test cases: the Madinah hotel is printed as 'ROSE PLATINUM / OLD NAME: RETAJ RAWDAH' in the first file and as 'RETAJ RAWDAH' alone in the second; and the Shawal page is issued 27-OCT-2026 in the first file and 17-OCT-2026 in the second. The second is the same-pack-different-issue-date conflict in docs/03 section 4 and test case T10.

Akabir Hijrah/Areej Wafa/Mather Elite is NOT a flat-room row, although docs/03 section 1 describes it as one. Its quad, triple and double figures equal ceil(room / occupancy) in all three packs, so it prices per person from the room rate. Treating it as flat_per_room would charge the full room price for a quad bed.
Al Kiswah Tower changes row type between packs: 300-SR flat in Ramadan Pack 01, ON BOOKING in Ramadan Pack 02, 100-SR flat in Shawal. Pricing mode must be read per pack, never carried over.
Qasr Al Sharq Tower and Hiba Hijrah-6 share one printed line at one rate in Ramadan Pack 01 and 02, but are separate rows at different rates in Shawal. They are treated as two hotels here.

Several names contain more than one hotel separated by a slash, at a single rate: Afwaj Al Momayaza /Shaza Wasam-3/4 Wahdat Al Khair, Badar Al Masa/Yasmin Al Majd, Akabir Hijrah/Areej Wafa/Mather Elite, Waqar Salmiya/Jood Marjan, Rua Al Khair/Burj Muktara. They are kept exactly as printed. Ask the supplier whether these are one property or several before splitting them.
'Any Hotel In Markazia' is a category the supplier sells, not a named property. It is seeded as printed; delete it in the admin portal if you do not want customers to pick it.

Distances are the DIST column as printed. Where that column holds two values (Swaed Al Khaima '400-M/500-M', Any Hotel In Markazia '250-M 300-M') distanceMeters is left null and the text is kept in distancePrinted.
The small print at the foot of each sheet (Urdu terms about visa refunds, over-stay and non-refundable packages) is deliberately not parsed, per CLAUDE.md rule 10. The original files stay the record.
